messages:
deploy-bot: auto-rollback initiated for release v3.0.4 -> trigger: error-rate spike (5xx >= 2.5% over 10m). starting rollback to v3.0.3 and initiating traffic shift. :rotating_light:
alana: hold on — we're seeing this error pattern only from a single tenant in eu-central-1 (FinanceCo). they asked us not to cut them over while we pull traces. can we stop the rest of the rollback and do a targeted mitigation?
diego: +1. prefer to pin eu-central-1 to v3.0.3 for customer routes and keep a small canary (10%) on v3.0.4 so we can capture full traces. also increase sampling and enable full model debug headers.
ops-oncall: current rollback progress: 45% complete. queued: cordon nodes eu-central-1-a,b, start traffic reroute. I can cancel remaining jobs but need explicit approval.
mira: approve cancel of remaining rollback steps for eu-central-1. please still proceed with region-wide pin via `deployctl pin --region eu-central-1 --version v3.0.3 --reason "tenant requested suppression"`.
ops-oncall: executing: `deployctl cancel 1743605000` -> success. `deployctl pin --region eu-central-1 --version v3.0.3 --reason "tenant requested suppression"` -> success, audit=pin-0a1b.
diego: adding steps: snapshot KV cache (`kvctl snapshot --region eu-central-1 --name pre-rollback-174360`), bump trace sampling to 100% for tenant FinanceCo, set model runtime debug env for shard 2.
tyler: creating internal incident INC-2024-2812, assign eng-runtime + eng-ml. adding runbook link and trace upload instructions.
alana: @ops-oncall please also preserve canary logs for 48h and tag them with `canary-v3.0.4-financeco`. we need request ids for 500s.
ops-oncall: done — log retention set, tags applied. canary traffic maintained at 10% for 2 hours; suppression window scheduled to expire at 1743608600.
deploy-bot: suppression recorded, reason "tenant debugging window". auto-rollback re-enable scheduled at 1743608600 unless extended manually.
mira: k, who will notify FinanceCo? want a short note: "We're looking into intermittent 5xx for some requests. We'll keep your service stable and gather traces; no service interruption expected. ETA update in 4 hours."
tyler: I'll send via support to FinanceCo PM now and CC their SRE. subject: "Investigating intermittent errors — traffic stabilized".
diego: initial glance at traces: spikes line up with KV miss storms on shard 2, and one-off decoder OOMs on a subset of model hosts. running repro job against the canary hosts now.
alana: if the repro confirms a model artifact regression, we only revert the model binary (leave infra changes). prefer model-only revert + quick canary, not full rollback.
ops-oncall: noted. I'll watch the suppression timer and will re-enable auto-rollback at the scheduled time if not extended.
tyler: incident created and ticket linked in thread. closing actions: FinanceCo notified, canary at 10% with verbose traces, KV snapshot taken, suppression pinned to v3.0.3 in eu-central-1. keep updates here; escalate to on-call lead if we need to flip traffic. :white_check_mark:"
